## Intent — what this is for

The wiring half of what WF2LOO-1 authored and WF2LOO-12 measured as unwired. The live judge path is taught to speak the contract instead of a bare word, and the 6 judge STAGES' already contract-shaped output stops being discarded. The two verdict vocabularies (judge_contract.Verdict PASS/REJECT/REPLAN/ESCALATE/NEEDS_INPUT vs verify.Verdict PASS/RETRY/ESCALATE/REJECT) are reconciled to ONE, not bridged - engine.py currently restates the sampling rule precisely to avoid feeding one vocabulary's values to the other's aggregator. Enforcement lands only after the population is measured: giving a never-run control teeth before the population satisfies it is an outage, which is why WF2LOO-12 deliberately did not. — plus (WF2LOO-15) judge_actors' four unwired functions: check_transition/resolve_transition need an actor on the node-transition path, blind_provenance/assemble_judge_evidence need the message-list evidence the one-word gate does not produce.

## Done when

GateKind.JUDGE asks for the contract JSON instead of one bare word; validate_verdict decides the gate, so a PASS without proof/evidence_refs is rejected rather than accepted; meets_ratchet compares the 14 declared runtime_hints.judge rubric criteria against their target_score for the first time; hints_from_dict becomes the parser of the declarations 6 templates already carry; the 6 judge STAGES' output is validated and bound by the templates that produce it (today zero templates bind nodes.judge.output.*); the two verdict enums are reconciled to one closed set with the loser deleted (clean break), keeping the pre-tier, sampling and cross-model isolation seams WF2LOO-6/WF2LOO-11 built. Gated on a prior measurement of how many real judge responses would satisfy the contract - measured blast radius: 7 judge gates in 7 bundled templates change prompt + parse; 6 templates x 14 rubric criteria become live thresholds (an unscored criterion is a 'not scored' shortfall, i.e. a REJECT, under Ratchet.STRICT); every judge answer grows from ~1 token to a JSON object on a gate that runs every loop iteration, plus a more frequent PROTOCOL failure mode on unparseable JSON. WF2LOO-12's rail is retired in the same change, since the docstring stops saying enforcement is not wired.
